items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: You know who had these pictures made? Earl. Earl Joseph.

ctx.x: I was wondering about the... Well, thank God as well as it is. I was wondering about those pictures that you showed us about when they were taken. If you remember this picture where he's holding his coronet, would you know about when that would be taken? Would that be when he was first married or later on? Oh, no.

Uh-uh. Is that in the... He had this taken. I don't know about that. Well, I'm trying to think who I could make these pictures. You know who had these pictures made? Earl. Earl Joseph. You know he's going to see Naomi? Yeah. Would you want...
